_note: Phase 9b predictive-chapter scaffold for year_ahead. fallback: The system flags this as a possible predictive chapter, not a finished claim about what will occur. Treat the research signal as a place to observe clustering: repeated questions, similar timing, or lived evidence that keeps returning to the same area. No meaning needs to be forced. Let circumstance, repetition, and your own record of events decide whether the signal deserves more weight.

profection_year.fallback: The system flags an annual emphasis here: one arena may ask for steadier attention across the year. This research signal does not predict drama or guarantee importance. It simply suggests that ordinary choices, responsibilities, and recurring situations may keep gathering around the same practical question. Notice what the year repeats, what it makes easier to measure, and where participation becomes more useful than speculation.
profection_year.identity: The system flags identity, presence, and self-definition as an annual emphasis. This research signal does not require a total reinvention. It suggests that the year may keep asking how you enter situations, claim your own name, and decide which version of yourself gets to lead. Watch for moments when an old presentation still functions socially but no longer feels honest in your body.
profection_year.resources: The system flags resources, appetite, possession, and self-worth as an annual emphasis. This research signal may become visible through earning, spending, pricing, saving, or the energy cost of keeping certain comforts intact. It is not automatically a lesson in restraint. The useful observation is which forms of security make you more alive, and which only keep a familiar anxiety well-fed.
profection_year.communication: The system flags communication, learning, and close-range life as an annual emphasis. This research signal may gather around conversations, writing, logistics, siblings, neighbors, short trips, or the agreements that keep daily reality moving. Listen for the message that needs better wording rather than more force. The year may reward accuracy: saying the right-sized thing in the right context, then letting response teach you.
profection_year.home: The system flags home, family, ancestry, and private foundations as an annual emphasis. This research signal may show through living arrangements, household roles, inherited habits, or the conditions that let you rest without performing wellness. It does not assume upheaval. It asks what kind of shelter your life now requires, and whether an old definition of safety is quietly asking to be updated.
profection_year.creativity: The system flags creativity, pleasure, romance, and play as an annual emphasis. This research signal may not look like constant inspiration; it may arrive through appetite returning, joy needing protection, or desire asking to be taken seriously. Notice where you feel more vivid. The year may teach you that delight is not decoration, and that being witnessed can be nourishing when it does not become performance.
profection_year.work: The system flags work, service, routines, and body maintenance as an annual emphasis. This research signal may appear through schedules, health rhythms, skill practice, task distribution, or the difference between being useful and being consumed. It is not a productivity sermon. It asks which systems make daily life more habitable, and which arrangements only look responsible because they have trained you to ignore strain.
profection_year.partnership: The system flags partnership, collaboration, and direct agreements as an annual emphasis. This research signal may gather through lovers, clients, allies, rivals, contracts, or conflicts that clarify relational terms. The focus is not simply whether a bond improves or ends. It is how you meet another person without misplacing your own truth, and how reciprocity behaves when it is tested by real conditions.
profection_year.transformation: The system flags intimacy, shared stakes, grief, debt, and deep change as an annual emphasis. This research signal may appear where trust has consequences and surface harmony no longer carries enough truth. It does not predict loss. It asks what must be metabolized, renegotiated, disclosed, or returned to its proper owner so that entanglement stops being confused with devotion.
profection_year.meaning: The system flags belief, study, travel, teaching, and worldview as an annual emphasis. This research signal may show up through a widened horizon, a spiritual question, a legal or educational matter, or an encounter with perspectives that make the old map too small. It does not demand certainty. It asks which ideas remain alive when experience, accountability, and practice all get a vote.
profection_year.vocation: The system flags vocation, visibility, reputation, and public contribution as an annual emphasis. This research signal may gather around leadership, recognition, responsibility, or the work required to make your role legible. It is not a status promise. It asks what kind of authority can be backed by structure, and what must mature privately before being asked to carry public weight.
profection_year.community: The system flags friendship, networks, audience, and collective belonging as an annual emphasis. This research signal may appear through invitations, group projects, future plans, or the social ecosystems where your energy either multiplies or thins out. Not every circle is a home. Watch where shared direction creates honest momentum, and where belonging depends on keeping a previous version of yourself available.
profection_year.spirit: The system flags solitude, surrender, hidden patterns, and inner repair as an annual emphasis. This research signal may first register through dreams, fatigue, privacy needs, endings, or what refuses to be solved by public effort. It does not turn withdrawal into virtue. It asks what becomes knowable when you stop overriding the quieter part of you that has been collecting evidence.

long_transit_cycle.home: The system flags home and belonging as a long-range research signal. long_transit_cycle.spirit: The system flags spirit and hidden life as a long-range research signal. return_year.communication: The system flags communication as a return-year research signal. return_year.partnership: The system flags partnership as a return-year research signal. sustained_transit_chapter.spirit: The system flags spirit as a sustained research signal. Dreams, solitude, endings, grief, hidden work, and rest may keep returning as information rather than interruption. This is not a verdict that you should disappear from life. It asks what the unseen pattern is trying to loosen, protect, or complete before the outer world moves cleanly.
